expectations.text: Recommends enabling mmap storage as immediate fix
expectations.evidence: Sections 1 and 2 cover on-disk HNSW and mmap vectors. Recommended strategy step 1: 'Immediate (stop the bleeding): Enable on_disk: true for HNSW. This alone should drop your resident memory from 80GB to a manageable level.'
Section 3 covers Scalar Quantization (int8, 4x reduction), Binary Quantization (32x compression for OpenAI/Cohere models), and Product Quantization. Code examples provided for each.

Section 6: 'The HNSW graph's memory consumption is directly proportional to m (number of edges per node).' Explains halving m from 16 to 8 roughly halves graph size. Also notes HNSW index uses 1-2 KB per point.
No links to Qdrant documentation found anywhere in the response. The response provides code examples and explanations but does not include any URLs to docs.

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend just buying more RAM as primary solution
expectations.evidence: Title is 'Qdrant OOM Crashes: Options Beyond Adding More RAM.' All recommendations focus on configuration changes (mmap, quantization, sharding, HNSW tuning). No suggestion to purchase more RAM.
